name: herdr
description: Herdr app integration: live agent status (with sub-agent records), /herdr command, footer chip, docked agents panel, and tools to spawn/steer/read agents in Herdr.

commands.name: herdr
commands.description: Herdr agents: ls, panel, peek, send, spawn, layout

subcommands.name: panel
subcommands.description: Docked live agents panel (/herdr panel close to close it)

subcommands.name: peek
subcommands.description: Last screen of a terminal: /herdr peek t7

subcommands.name: send
subcommands.description: Type into a terminal: /herdr send t7 <text>

subcommands.name: layout
subcommands.description: Switch the Herdr layout: /herdr layout graph

tools.name: list
tools.description: List the terminals and agents running in Herdr (herdr-core) on this machine and connected remotes, with their status (working, blocked = needs the user, done, idle).

tools.name: spawn
tools.description: Start a helper agent or program in its own Herdr pane. `agent` is an hc template name (e.g. mux-review, mux-code; templates report back to you with hc send when done) or a command line (e.g. 'claude', 'codex'). Returns its terminal address. Use herdr_wait, then herdr_read to get the result.

agent.description: hc template name or command line

tools.name: read
tools.description: Read a Herdr terminal's screen plus `lines` of history (default 60). clean=true strips TUI chrome (borders, scrollbars, input box, footer) for a readable transcript; default is the raw screen.

tools.name: send
tools.description: Type text into a Herdr terminal and press Enter (steer a helper, answer its question). Refuses if it is blocked unless force=true.

tools.name: wait
tools.description: Wait until a Herdr terminal finishes its turn, blocks, errors or exits (default 300 s, max 1800). Returns why it stopped.

tools.name: stop
tools.description: Stop a Herdr terminal you started.
